answer: Each identity must bind one certified rescue dog team: a handler and one dog trained two years, certified after a live field test in orchard terrain, dog microchip and handler ID filed under the key, one team per identity, duplicates rejected. Per fake: one handler, one dog, 4,500 units, 730 days, plus a yearly mesa re-test. 100 fakes: 450,000 units, 100 teams, 73,000 days. Cheapest cheat: renting a team for test day, 6,000 units, but the dog obeys only its handler, so a stranger fails, the lender loses certification, and a forged certificate fails the opal-sealed check.
